title: Present complete authenticated Promo with safe advertising fallback

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Promo display API tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/promo/test_promo_display_api.py

verify.summary: Compacted retained final functional PASS. Current task status is done_for_prod.
Compacted final lifecycle closure: current task status is done_for_prod.

evidence_required: FT-005-AC-001 RED: the current result branch has no authenticated teaser endpoint or complete four-teaser Promo/QR renderer; GREEN: one exact v1 result renders four decoded teaser slots tied to four distinct issued disposable references, the accepted copy and a fully visible locally generated high-contrast QR at logical 1920x1080, with programmatic decode; decisive comparison: issued reference identities and target-layout assertions. Real media-byte distinctness, no-watermark content and representative-phone scanning are deferred to post-deployment acceptance; artifact: automated receipts plus logical-target browser evidence under .tasks/TASK-076-T3-FT-005-W1/.

FT-005-AC-005 RED: the current result state cannot reject partial media/QR/render failure as one integrated Promo outcome; GREEN: partial, stale, fewer-than-four, camera, network, processing, missing/undecodable media and optional-asset fixtures all leave or return the client to usable advertising, emit no final Promo/Chime or success cooldown, and preserve the accepted replaceable communication notice; decisive comparison: client state/event/timer trace for every named branch; artifact: redacted browser and focused-test evidence under .tasks/TASK-076-T3-FT-005-W1/.
purpose: Complete the participant-visible success/failure branch by resolving exactly the issued authenticated teasers and rendering final Promo only when the full result is valid.
success_outcome: A valid result produces one exact four-teaser truthful Promo with a visible local QR, while every invalid, partial, stale or failed branch stays or returns to advertising without success cooldown.
anti_goals: Do not change realtime selection, search, teaser choice, result-session truth or N.
Do not implement display acknowledgement persistence, independent timers or phone continuation in this task.
Do not expose raw MinIO keys, presigned participant URLs, partial Promo, replacement media or an external QR service.

forbidden_scope: Realtime search/assembly algorithms and serving-setting mutation
QR ticket exchange, phone browser-access state and purchase navigation
Production credentials, operator/default rows or unredacted personalized artifacts
stop_conditions: Authenticated media cannot be resolved through promo-owned session authorization and accepted inventory/processing projections.
Business orchestration would need to move into an HTTP handler, infrastructure helper or composition root.
Complete Promo would require a new public origin, direct MinIO access, response-shape change or unresolved product choice.
T3 evidence cannot use isolated task-owned principals, rows, objects and cleanup.

constraints: Primary owner is promo under src/face_moment/promo/; SpaPromoClient is the external presentation party and backend is wiring only.
Cross only the accepted promo to inventory/processing Participant Promo projections; providers retain all Photo, visibility, derivative and processing writes.
Authenticate the display Bearer principal, derive spa_id from its stored hash and return no-store media without raw storage identity.
Use unique task-owned display client, Photo/session/Attempt rows and private object keys with known initial state, safe rerun identifiers, observable outcome and owned cleanup.

Use playwright cli for the agent-run development-closure browser proof: load the central-origin SpaPromoClient at logical 1920x1080, drive complete and incomplete result fixtures with four distinct issued disposable references (a shared disposable placeholder byte is allowed for the local rendering flow), and retain the CLI transcript and logical-target screenshots/video/trace under .tasks/TASK-076-T3-FT-005-W1/. The authorized representative-phone scan belongs to post-deployment acceptance and is not a stop condition while the pilot environment is unavailable.
Keep the QR implementation local, release-owned and minimal; do not add an external service or a second general client framework.

The independently verified Attempt 2 provider-edge result (zero direct provider queries, no forbidden provider imports and authenticated SPA scope) is supporting development-stage evidence; development closure still requires four distinct issued references and programmatic QR decode. Real-photo, physical-phone, target-hardware and media-byte/no-watermark evidence is deferred to post-deployment acceptance; a shared disposable placeholder is not proof of those pilot properties.
invariants: Final Promo requires exactly four unique decoded issued teasers, exact truthful copy and one fully visible high-contrast QR.
Unknown, foreign, unavailable or hard-purged media produces no replacement, partial Promo, session mutation or N recalculation.
Every non-success path starts no final Chime or success cooldown and retry uses a fresh capture.
Token, digest, personalized payload and raw object identity never enter URLs, logs or retained evidence.
verification_targets: Playwright CLI loads the central-origin client at logical 1920x1080, renders the exact complete fixture, rejects each incomplete/failure fixture, and retains transcript plus logical-target screenshots/video/trace for the AC-001/AC-005 verdict.

Task-owned API/browser evidence proves authenticated issued-media scope, four decoded previews tied to four distinct issued disposable references, programmatic local QR decode, safe advertising fallback, promo ownership and zero foreign writes without adopting provider-task proof. Representative-phone, target-screen, real-media-byte and no-watermark pilot evidence is deferred to post-deployment acceptance and is not required for this implementation task's closure.
